meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为 HyperFrames 动效编写可拖动进度条定位的 2D/3D 关键帧，建立受控时间线，并用 hyperframes 命令校验画面，失败就修正重跑。它只处理关键帧任务，不负责整体场景规划。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要可定位关键帧、GSAP/CSS 时间线、路径/遮罩/SVG 形变等，或要求运行 hyperframes keyframes 检查时触发；不用于整体场景规划。

say.text: 帮我给这个 HyperFrames 合成加上 2D 关键帧，终点停在最终状态
运行 hyperframes keyframes 检查并告诉我哪里不通过
say.note: 它会跑诊断并指出需要修的中间帧

say.text: 这段路径动画太快了，帮我保持匀速并加 proof 截图
say.note: 会调整 ease 并用 --shot 验证

howto.what_en: Claude writes seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames, builds and registers paused timelines, then verifies via hyperframes lint/check/keyframes and shots, fixing and re-running on failure. Keyframe work only; not scene planning.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe keyframes, GSAP/CSS timelines, paths/masks/SVG morph, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics; not for scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general planning.

say_en.text: Add 2D keyframes to this HyperFrames comp, ending on the final state
say_en.note: Claude writes a seekable timeline following the pose contract

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes and tell me what fails
say_en.note: It runs diagnostics and flags missing middle poses

say_en.text: This path move is too fast; keep it steady and add proof shots
